profile_text.body:
Micron Technology Inc. is a public company headquartered in Boise, Idaho, traded under the ticker MU and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000723125. On its own website the company describes itself as a global leader in memory and storage, saying it powers AI and compute-intensive applications from cloud to edge with semiconductor solutions. The site also presents mobile memory and storage as accelerating AI-driven technologies, and offers resources such as data sheets, design tools, a Technology Enablement Program, sales support, and an online source for placing and tracking orders for Micron memory samples.

The harvested site text is largely navigational and promotional, so it names no specific products beyond memory and storage generally. No products are tracked in the record, and no MCP servers are listed. The record shows no lawsuits involving the company.

The only additional held fact is a law exposure entry for Idaho, with a count of 21.
